name: microsip-call-log-sync
description: Sistema de sincronizacion de llamadas MicroSIP

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd dashboard && npm install
scripts.build-all: npm run build-server && cd dashboard && npm run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n SERVER,AGENT,DASHBOARD -c blue,green,magenta "npm run start-server" "npm run start-agent" "npm run dev-dashboard"
